newsitem.title: CHINA: Annan begins first China visit as U.N. chief.
newsitem.headline: Annan begins first China visit as U.N. chief.

text.p: United Nations Secretary-General Kofi Annan on Wednesday began a courtesy visit to China, his first trip to the world's most populous nation since his appointment last year.
Annan was scheduled to meet Chinese President Jiang Zemin on Thursday and would have discussions with Foreign Minister Qian Qichen and economic officials, a U.N. diplomat said.
During his five-day visit, Annan would visit the Pudong economic development zone in Shanghai as well as the ancient city of Xi'an, the diplomat said.
"This is a courtesy visit," she said.
China, a permanent member of the U.N. Security Council, has prided itself on its good relations with United Nations leaders.
Beijing welcomed Annan's appointment last December, even though it had supported a second term for his predecessor, Boutros Boutros-Ghali.
